title: Clear Roadblocks Build Plan
eyebrow: Build plan · parent issue #569, design approved 2026-11-22

short.lead: The roadblocks rule is built in three steps under parent issue #569: the rule text, a reply check that blocks twice then warns, and the tests, docs and version.
short.hint: Tap a step to see it.
items: #570: the rule text and its detail file
Adds the section "Roadblocks are mine to clear" to the rules file and a detail file, linked from the evidence and users-hands rules.
#571: the check that blocks twice, then warns
Extends the end-of-reply evidence check to flag roadblock claims with no probe. Two blocks, then a warning line. A state file holds the count and resets on each new message.

items.caption: Never more than two blocks per message, so a session cannot hang.

items: #572: tests, docs, version and QA page
Adds verify.py cases, updates the docs and changelog, bumps the plugin version, and posts a QA page.
Nothing from you until the QA page.

items.caption: Step 3 proves and records the change.

changes: Done when: the section and detail file exist, verify.py passes its duplication and size checks, and CLAUDE.md carries no copy.
Step 2 adds the roadblock claim check.
Done when: a roadblock claim with no probe is blocked twice then passes with a warning, a probe-first reply is not blocked, and an unreadable state file is reported in words.
Done when: verify.py and verify_tools.py exit 0, the GitHub check is green, and the QA page is linked from #569.

wrapup.summary: This plan builds the roadblocks rule and its check in three steps, one issue each.
wrapup.changing: The rules file, a new detail file, the evidence check in core.py, verify.py, and the docs.
wrapup.next: After you approve, I build step 1 (#570).
